$comment: Single declared source for the S3 buckets the training stack owns (ADR-008 derive-dont-hardcode, bucket consolidation R1.2). training/stack.ts, module-runner.cjs (adopt flags + implicit import) and every derived consumer read this file. Placeholders: {account} {region} {profile}. test/unit/no-literal-bucket-names.test.js allows each name ONLY here. ArtifactsBucket keeps the physical name of the pre-existing MLflow artifact store (owner decision D7); it is called 'artifacts' everywhere except here.

ArtifactsBucket.name: mlcc-tune-{account}-{region}
ArtifactsBucket.purpose: Per-project raw job artifacts (<project>/tune|train|optimize/...) and the MLflow App artifact store

TrainingBucket.name: mlcc-training-{account}-{region}
TrainingBucket.purpose: Legacy (frozen): reward-evaluator code backups and pre-consolidation training data

AdaptersBucket.name: mlcc-training-adapters-{account}-{region}
AdaptersBucket.purpose: Legacy (frozen in Wave 6.1): do/adapter staging for SageMaker inference components
